text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, I was out shopping with Furioso.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I want her to let her hair down and 
unwind to the fullest. To help with that, 
I resolved to enjoy myself first.
choice_data_list: Well, maybe I'll try one of them on!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Then how about that T-shirt over there? I 
think it would suit you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Huh... I feel like I've seen this design 
somewhere before—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I remember now. We made matching 
T-shirts with everyone in Funabashi, 
didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer drew an original character... 
Fufu, it looks just like your draft from 
back then.
choice_data_list:
Whoa, don't remind me of embarrassing 
stuff!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, that did happen. If 
I recall, that was a doodle I made that I 
accidentally put on display..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, there's nothing to be ashamed of. 
It was quite adorable, wasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
See, you really do look like them. I 
personally like this character, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso's expression is softer than usual. 
Let's keep this momentum going.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, both in high spirits, they 
visited places they wouldn't normally drop 
by.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Huh... It has such a mature atmosphere, 
wouldn't you say? It feels like I've 
stepped into a completely different world.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: I'm feeling strangely nervous somehow.
choice_data_list: Sorry. Want to move somewhere else?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, it's not like that. I was just 
thinking that this racing heart doesn't 
feel so bad.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Opportunities like this are rare unless 
I'm with you, Trainer. Let's enjoy it 
together.
choice_data_list: Yeah, you're right!
Yeah, you're right!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'll go first.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Um, could you look away for a bit? It's 
putting pressure on me...!
choice_data_list:
Ahaha, you're more nervous now than before 
the race.

Ahaha, you look more nervous than before 
the race!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Please don't laugh... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The sunset is dazzling... The day really 
flew by, didn't it?
choice_data_list:
Did you get to enjoy yourself to the 
fullest today?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. If anything, I let my 
guard down a little too much.
choice_data_list: It's fine, at least on your day off.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I have the peace of mind to 
empathize now.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Without a doubt, it's all thanks to 
Trainer taking me to so many different 
places.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Besides... it reminded me of how I used to 
spend my time back in Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes going out with my Trainer, going 
to the beach, laughing over silly little 
things.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
So today made me really happy. —It felt as 
if my precious day off had finally 
returned.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Could we set aside another day to 
just relax and spend time together?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's go out together again.
Yeah, let's go out together again.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It's a promise. From here on out, just 
like back in Funabashi—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No, even more so than back in Funabashi. 
Let's make this a fun day off for the two 
of us.
choice_data_list: I'm glad I got to see that smile today.
Where would you like to go next?

I'll need to clear my schedule ahead of 
time.

We'll need to clear our schedule ahead of 
time.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No, even more so than back in Funabashi. 
Let's make this a fun day off for the two 
of us.
choice_data_list: I'm glad I got to see that smile today.
Where would you like to go next?

I'll need to clear my schedule ahead of 
time.

We'll need to clear our schedule ahead of 
time.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Huh, it's not like it's anything rare, is 
it? You've seen plenty of them since way 
back.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Well, whether they go back to making that 
stern face might just depend on you, 
Trainer.
choice_data_list: Of course, leave that to me!
Of course, leave that to me!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The smile never left Furioso's face, and 
she enjoyed her time off to the absolute 
fullest!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Somewhere not too intimidating would be 
nice. For example—how about the shopping 
district?
choice_data_list: Ah, that's a great idea!
Yeah, that's a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Right, please make sure not to lose your 
wallet, okay? Do you remember where it is?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I searched frantically for it, only to 
find it in my bag all along... Hehe, it 
brings back memories.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she looked back on everything so far, 
Furioso gave a smile just like she used to 
back in Funabashi!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Do you have work piling up, by any chance?
choice_data_list: Well, I'd be lying if I said it was zero.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Then pass whatever you can to me. There's 
no need to hold back here.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Take care of business, then enjoy your 
time off. That was a promise too... hehe."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to Furioso's next day off, 
the two of them made plans together with 
smiles on their faces!
